market_context.target_market: Electric Vehicle (EV) and Energy Storage Systems (ESS)
market_context.growth_outlook: Strong growth driven by increasing EV adoption and demand for ESS. High-nickel cathode materials, solid-state electrolytes, and advanced packaging are expected to be key enablers.

planned_roadmap.name: High-Nickel Cathode Materials
planned_roadmap.justification: Rapidly scale production of high-nickel cathode materials to meet growing EV demand. Focus on improving stability and cycle life.

planned_roadmap.name: Solid State Electrolytes
planned_roadmap.justification: Develop and test prototype solid-state batteries. Address challenges related to interface resistance and ionic conductivity.

planned_roadmap.name: Dry Electrode Coating
planned_roadmap.justification: Establish pilot production lines for dry electrode coating to validate cost savings and improve production efficiency.
